fact: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation invited bids (closing 14 January 2026) under World Bank grant E-1920-SS for the supply, installation and commissioning of one EumetCast Satellite Ground Station in Juba.
title: Specific Procurement Notice: Supply, Installation, Commissioning and After-Sales Services of Hydrometric Monitoring Stations, and EumetCast Satellite Ground Station
publisher: Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation, South Sudan
